title: Baba Is You
notes: Native Linux build 24529734 installed through the official Steam client and launched directly in an isolated profile; the native build runs without a Steam API connection. Timing is turn based: nothing on a level or the world map moves until the player presses a key, so pausing during decisions changes nothing and there is no frozen condition. The game has no difficulty setting; every Trial starts a new game on the opening level, which is not skipped because clearing it is the first step of the first milestone. The game writes its slot save on level entry, after every cleared level and when an area is completed.
introduction: Baba Is You is a turn-based puzzle game. Each level is a grid of objects and word tiles; rows or columns of words such as BABA IS YOU or FLAG IS WIN form the rules that are currently true. Pushing word tiles changes the rules, for example making a wall passable or a different object the winner. You clear a level by reaching an object that is WIN while you control something that is YOU. Levels sit on world maps: clearing levels opens paths to more levels and new areas, and the game ends after the final level of the main route. The run starts from a fresh save on the opening level.
controls: Arrow keys move (one tile per press). Z undoes the last move, R restarts the level, Space waits a turn, Return selects a level on the map and Escape opens the menu.
